entries.zh: 不可比拟，无可匹敌；至极、不胜（如「不勝歡喜」即欢喜不尽）
entries.en: not to be equalled; beyond comparison; exceedingly (不勝歡喜: overjoyed)
entries.notes: R 栏西文注记「mucho mal gozo」与 M 之「歡喜」呼应而语义含混，L 之 exíito/exceso 未能定，故降等。

entries.en: cannot be compared with; no match for
entries.notes: H 首字有 [疑:袂/秩]，M 之 bēy 与「袂」相合，取「袂比得」义。

entries.en: not to be imagined; beyond conceiving
entries.notes: L 之 ymaginallo 与 H 之「惴/揣」均有 [疑]，取「揣度、想象」义。

entries.en: no need; it does not matter
not worth reckoning; of no account
entries.notes: H 末字 [疑:載]、M 之 cāy chāy 未能逐字对应，义据 L 与「無該」定。

entries.en: regardless; no matter; unrestricted
no harm; it is all right
regardless; irrespective
never mind; no problem
ordinary; nothing out of the common
of no consequence; a matter of no importance
entries.notes: H「勝甲」[疑]、M 之 là cēh 未能与汉字对应，义仅据 L 之 no importa。

entries.en: a trifling matter; of little importance
a laughing matter; not to be taken seriously
entries.notes: L 明言 cosa de burla；H「免推」[疑] 与 M 之 biān chúi 仅部分相应。

entries.en: nothing; it is nothing
entries.notes: L 之 una 有 [疑]；M 并录 bô（白读）与 bû（文读）两音，末音 chū 未详。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（字面为「没有、无」）
entries.en: 〔damaged; gloss uncertain〕 (lit. 'not to have')
entries.notes: M 栏 T99 污损，H「了/子」与 M「güer/quier」皆未定，仅 L 之 no tener 可读。

entries.en: no; not
not (classical negative)
no; not (character probably a corruption of 否)
entries.notes: L 之 no. 与 H「冒」义不合，M 之 har 疑为「否」hōⁿ 之音写，字形与音读两失。

entries.en: how could it be (rhetorical negative)
entries.notes: M 之 gūy 与「豈」读不合，义据 H 与 L 之 no.。

entries.zh: 乎（疑问语气词，构成是非问）
entries.en: interrogative particle forming yes/no questions
entries.notes: 「乎」本非否定词，然列于 no. 之下，当为构成是非问之用。

entries.en: cease; do not (prohibitive)
